decisions.reason: A formwork profile line close to the core offer with its own web page costs little to keep, and one year on the market has not resolved its value, so the option stays open.
The automated distributor flow control supports the firm's automation strategy and is embedded in its systems, and its uncertain upside justifies keeping it at low holding cost.
The shuttering magnet line is a low-cost accessory adjacent to the core business with no negative evidence yet, so abandoning it would be premature.
The magnetic formwork strips have their own page and several models, which signals commitment, and they cost little to maintain while demand is still revealed.
The component has its own web presence and sits close to the established formwork offer, so keeping it is cheap while its value is still uncertain.

This component is only mentioned on the website and overlaps with other magnetic options, making it the likeliest to be consolidated, but holding costs are minimal and the evidence is not yet decisive.
